Exercise 4.1 · Week 4

Pop the Balloon

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: use a variable to count pops and pick random to move the balloon. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project: File > New. Delete the cat (right-click > delete).
  2. Click Choose a Sprite and pick Balloon1.
  3. Click Variables > Make a Variable. Type pops, keep For all sprites, click OK. A pops box appears on the stage.
  4. Build the two scripts below. pick random is in Operators: drop one into the x slot and one into the y slot of go to x: y:.
  5. Click the green flag and pop the balloon a few times.
  6. Click the green flag again. Does pops start at 0?
  7. Experiment: take away set pops to 0 and click the flag. What happens? Put it back.
  8. Add a credits comment: right-click the code area > Add Comment > "Credits: Balloon sprite and Pop sound from the Scratch library."
  9. Save as pop-balloon.

The scripts in words

Balloon sprite, two scripts:

  1. when green flag clicked
    • set pops to 0
    • go to x: 0 y: 0
  2. when this sprite clicked
    • change pops by 1
    • start sound Pop
    • go to x: (pick random -200 to 200) y: (pick random -140 to 140)

Expected behavior

When you click the green flag, pops shows 0 and the balloon is in the middle. Every time you click the balloon, pops goes up by 1, you hear a pop, and the balloon jumps to a surprise place. Without set pops to 0, a new game starts with the old score.

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

You need two scripts on the Balloon. One starts the game when the flag is clicked. The other runs when the balloon is clicked. Look for the Variables category for pops.

Hint 2: Try this

Use the when this sprite clicked block (Events category) for the second script. Inside it, use change pops by to count. For the surprise spot, drop pick random blocks (Operators category) into the slots of go to x: y: (Motion category).

Hint 3: Almost there

The flag script has two blocks: one that sets the counter and one that puts the balloon in a starting place. The click script has three: one that changes the counter, a start sound block (Sound category), and one that moves the balloon to a random place using pick random ____ to ____ twice.
